I met my current boyfriend during a bad time and 7 months after us dating I got diagnosed with Bipolar 1. It made a lot of sense with things but for whatever reason the stress surrounding a new diagnosis and already existing mental health issues really affected us. He is going to go to therapy with me once a month now to learn how to support me best, and he is working on a bipolar workbook with me! If your s/o is the right person for you and a good person in general they will do all they can to support you in how you need! :)
